AI Data Platform Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Data Platform Engineer

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2

Experience Required: 6+ years

We are seeking a AI Data Platform Engineer to define and lead the architecture of our enterprise data platform, spanning ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and consumption layers. The role drives the strategic direction of data infrastructure, sets standards for data modeling and lifecycle management, and partners with data engineering, analytics, ML, and business stakeholders to deliver a coherent, scalable data foundation. Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related fieldEight or more years of experience in data engineering, with significant time in architecture rolesDeep expertise across at least two major data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or RedshiftStrong understanding of lakehouse architectures, modern table formats, and streaming systemsHands-on experience with Spark, Flink, or Kafka at production scaleStrong data modeling expertise across dimensional, normalized, and data-vault patternsExperience implementing governance, lineage, and catalog capabilitiesSolid grasp of cloud platforms, networking, identity, and cost optimizationExcellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skillsTrack record of leading large data platform initiatives across teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with data mesh or data product architecturesFamiliarity with semantic layers such as dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, or LookMLExposure to regulated industries with strict data residency or audit requirementsCloud or platform certifications (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, GCP)Public talks or writing on data architecture

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Forward Engineer – AI, Cloud & Orchestration to help enterprise organizations design, build, and deploy next-generation solutions leveraging artificial intelligence, cloud technologies, automation, and intelligent orchestration.

This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex business challenges, developing cutting-edge technology, and bringing innovative solutions from concept to production.

Unlike traditional architecture or consulting positions, this role combines deep technical engineering expertise with direct customer engagement. You'll work closely with business leaders, technical stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand challenges, design solutions, write code, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a technically versatile problem-solver with strong experience in Generative AI, Microsoft Azure, software development, enterprise integrations, and workflow automation.

What You'll Be Doing

AI Engineering & Intelligent Automation

• Design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications, intelligent agents, copilots, and automated workflows.
• Build solutions using leading LLM platforms, including OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Microsoft Azure AI.
• Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions and enterprise knowledge architectures.
• Integrate AI capabilities into existing enterprise applications, business processes, and operational environments.
• Rapidly transform business requirements into prototypes, minimum viable products (MVPs), and production-ready solutions.
• Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify practical applications that deliver measurable business value.


Enterprise Orchestration & Integration

• Design and implement intelligent workflows connecting applications, APIs, enterprise data, infrastructure, AI agents, and business processes.
• Automate complex processes spanning multiple systems, departments, and technologies.
• Develop event-driven workflows that monitor conditions, analyze data, recommend actions, and trigger automated responses.
• Integrate business rules, approval processes, governance controls, and human-in-the-loop decision-making.
• Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes, improve operational efficiency, and streamline enterprise workflows.


Cloud Architecture & Engineering

• Design and implement secure, scalable cloud and hybrid-cloud solutions, primarily within Microsoft Azure.
• Develop and support cloud modernization, application integration, and infrastructure automation initiatives.
• Work with cloud networking, compute, storage, identity, security, containers, and data services.
• Evaluate existing enterprise environments and recommend practical future-state architectures.
• Apply cloud cost optimization and FinOps principles to engineering decisions.


Software Development & DevOps

• Design and develop production-quality software, APIs, integrations, and automation solutions.
• Write clean, scalable, maintainable code, preferably using Python and modern development frameworks.
• Integrate enterprise applications using REST APIs, webhooks, event streams, and other integration technologies.
• Implement CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code where appropriate.
• Build reusable automation components and integration frameworks.


Observability, SRE & Operational Intelligence

• Design and integrate observability solutions across cloud platforms, applications, infrastructure, and enterprise systems.
• Leverage tools such as Grafana, Azure Monitor, and ServiceNow to improve operational visibility.
• Correlate logs, metrics, traces, and events to identify issues and improve system performance.
• Apply AI-driven analytics to anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, predictive operations, and automated remediation.
• Support reliability engineering practices, including service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and operational readiness.


Data, Security & AI Governance

• Integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data into AI and automation solutions.
• Develop data pipelines and integrations that support intelligent applications.
• Incorporate security, identity management, access controls, and data protection into solution designs.
• Support responsible AI adoption through appropriate governance, auditability, human oversight, and compliance controls.


What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, solution architecture, DevOps, SRE, automation, or related technical disciplines.
• Proven experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale technology solutions.
• Strong hands-on expertise with Microsoft Azure and cloud architecture.
• Practical experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-powered applications.
• Experience building or integrating AI agents, agentic workflows, or intelligent automation solutions.
• Strong programming and software development skills, with Python strongly preferred.
• Experience developing APIs and integrating complex enterprise systems.
• Solid understanding of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and modern application architectures.
• Experience with workflow automation and orchestration.
• Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and enterprise operations.
• Understanding of enterprise data integration, security, and governance.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate directly with business executives, customers, and technical teams.


Preferred Technical Experience

Experience with several of the following technologies and disciplines is highly desirable:

• AI & LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Claude Code, Azure OpenAI, AI agents, RAG, vector databases, and agentic frameworks.
• Cloud & DevOps: Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, AWS, Kubernetes, containers, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD.
• Automation & Integration: Python, REST APIs, event-driven architecture, workflow orchestration, and enterprise integration platforms.
• Observability & Operations: Grafana, Azure Monitor, ServiceNow, SRE, automated remediation, and FinOps.
• Enterprise Platforms: Microsoft 365, Copilot, enterprise data platforms, and business process automation.
• Experience supporting healthcare, financial services, or other highly regulated enterprise environments is a plus.


Beyond the Technical Skills

We're looking for someone who can do more than design an impressive architecture.

The ideal candidate will be able to:

• Engage directly with business and IT leaders to understand complex operational challenges.
• Translate business needs into practical, scalable technical solutions.
• Move seamlessly between strategic discussions, solution design, and hands-on development.
• Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
• Collaborate across software engineering, infrastructure, security, data, and business teams.
• Take ownership of solutions from initial discovery through implementation and production.
• Thrive in environments where requirements evolve and creative problem-solving is essential.
• Balance innovation with security, reliability, cost, and measurable business value.


The Ideal Candidate

We're looking for a builder, not just an architect.

You might spend the morning collaborating with enterprise leaders to understand a business challenge, the afternoon designing an AI-enabled solution, and the following days writing code, integrating platforms, and bringing that solution into production.

You understand how to connect the entire technology ecosystem:

Business Processes → Data → AI → Applications → Cloud → Observability → Automation → Business Outcomes

You're curious, adaptable, technically broad, and passionate about turning emerging technologies into real-world enterprise solutions.

Why This Opportunity?

This position offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, combining advanced software engineering, cloud architecture, and intelligent automation. You'll have the chance to solve challenging business problems, work directly with enterprise customers, influence technical direction, and build solutions that deliver meaningful operational impact.  If you're a hands-on engineer who enjoys working across AI, cloud, software development, and enterprise automation—and wants to see your solutions make a real difference—we'd love to connect.

jobs_results.description:
## About the Role

Your primary mandate is to accelerate delivery of business-unit solutions by building AI systems that generate, validate, and ship infrastructure-as-code – Terraform in particular – so environments are stood up faster and more consistently. You will architect agentic applications and workflows on AWS, apply intelligent automation across the platform and cloud operations, and pioneer emerging agentic techniques. As a technical leader, you will set direction, establish standards and guardrails, and mentor engineers while remaining hands-on with design and implementation.

This role is based in NY/NJ with a hybrid work mode (2-3 days onsite). The pay range is $150K-$170K per year base plus annual bonus. The posted range is the hiring range for this role – a subset of the broader range available to employees over time – and reflects base salary across our national hiring scale. Final offers are based on several factors, including the candidate's skills and experience, internal pay equity, work location, market conditions for the role, and the specific scope and responsibilities of the position. The top of the range is reserved for candidates who notably exceed the requirements; the lower end applies to those with less experience or fewer preferred qualifications. For positions based in higher-cost zones (e.g., California, New York, New Jersey), actual compensation may exceed the posted range; your recruiter will share specifics during the process. For more information on benefits and what we offer, please visit https://www.exlservice.com/us-careers-and-benefits.

## AI

- Driven Infrastructure Delivery

You will design and build AI agents and tools that generate, validate, and refactor infrastructure-as-code – Terraform in particular – to accelerate the delivery of business-unit solutions. Embed guardrails, policy-as-code, and automated validation into the generation workflow so generated infrastructure adheres to standards, security policy, and reusable module patterns before it reaches production. Reduce provisioning lead time and rework by integrating AI-assisted code generation and review into the CI/CD toolchain (Git. Hub, Jenkins, Artifactory, Sonar. Qube). Curate and maintain a library of reusable Terraform modules, blueprints, and golden patterns that agents can compose to stand up new environments quickly and consistently.

## Agentic AI & LLM Applications

Architect and build agentic applications and multi-agent systems using modern agent frameworks (e.g., Lang. Chain, Amazon Bedrock Agents) to automate infrastructure, platform, and operations workflows. Apply and advance emerging agentic techniques such as context engineering, agent harnesses, tool/function calling, and evaluation loops to improve agent reliability and autonomy. Implement RAG pipelines (retrieval-augmented generation) over internal knowledge sources – runbooks, architecture docs, Terraform modules, and ITSM history – to ground agent behavior. Establish patterns and standards for prompt/context engineering, model selection, evaluation, cost management, and responsible

- AI guardrails (security, privacy, and hallucination controls).

## AIOps & Cloud Operations

Apply AIOps for anomaly detection, event correlation, and automated remediation across the cloud estate and automation platform. Reduce mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve by integrating AI into ITSM (ticket triage, classification, routing, and self-healing runbooks) to accelerate cloud operations.

## Platform, Delivery & Leadership

Own the LLMOps/agent-ops foundation for agentic AI workloads – pipelines, deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and lifecycle management – on AWS. Partner with security, data governance, and legal teams to ensure AI solutions meet compliance and responsible

- AI requirements. Set technical direction, define the AI roadmap for the platform, and provide architecture governance. Mentor engineers, run design reviews, and grow agentic

- AI capability across the team.
